@rajgarh_mamta1 An 8-month-old baby in #Bengaluru has been diagnosed with the first known case of #humanmetapneumovirus (HMPV) in the country. 

#HMPV, a respiratory virus affecting the lungs and airways, poses higher risks for young children, the elderly, and those with weakened immune systems. https://t.co/diEJuWkWJa
